L01_female.wav.speaker: female
L01_female.wav.text: Did you get a chance to enjoy the sunshine yesterday afternoon?

L02_male.wav.speaker: male
L02_male.wav.text: Not really, because I had to finish up our quarterly budget report.

L03_female.wav.speaker: female
L03_female.wav.text: That sounds tough, but at least the weather is going to stay nice.

L04_male.wav.speaker: male
L04_male.wav.text: I hope so, since I want to go camping with my brother this weekend.

L05_female.wav.speaker: female
L05_female.wav.text: That would be great, but do you have time for a quick question?

L06_male.wav.speaker: male
L06_male.wav.text: Sure, what do you need to talk about before our afternoon meeting?

L07_female.wav.speaker: female
L07_female.wav.text: I was wondering if we could go over the slides together before lunch.

L08_male.wav.speaker: male
L08_male.wav.text: Sounds good, so let's meet in the conference room at eleven thirty.
